'''Ruf-Asti-Viarffli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] who served as [[President/Legends|President]] of the [[Dohnia free colony]]. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], he attended the launch of the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] ''[[Gem of Alderaan]]'', on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
